profile.headline: Team Lead, Business Analyst, Solution Architect and Application Developer
profile.summary: Accomplished professional with a history of success and experience in software development projects.  Known for meeting challenges and creating positive change.  An accomplished leader with in-depth experience and a proven track record of success in building high-performing teams and leading them to create practical, reliable and stable solutions in demanding environments.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description: JPMorgan Chase & Co. (NYSE: JPM) is a leading global financial services firm with assets of $2.6 trillion and operations worldwide. The Firm is a leader in investment banking, financial services for consumers and small businesses, commercial banking, financial transaction processing, and asset management. A component of the Dow Jones Industrial Average, JPMorgan Chase & Co. serves millions of consumers in the United States and many of the world's most prominent corporate, institutional and government clients under its J.P. Morgan and Chase brands. Information about JPMorgan Chase & Co. is available at www.jpmorganchase.com.

positions.title: Consultant
positions.description: Oracle consultant for evaluating architecture, functional testing, performance analysis, database optimization, and RAC failover testing for a system upgrade to develop a self-clearing brokerage product in regards to data conversion between Pershing LLC and Thomson Reuters Beta Systems and the re-engineering of batch and server side business processes to use asynchronous messaging (Oracle AQ).

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description: NASA-Johnson Space Center development of Constellation Operations for Mission Control, Level A/B requirements, Use-cases Functional Architecture, Data Architecture, System Engineering, Trade Studies, Oracle Web Application Development prototypes.

positions.title: Oracle Consultant
positions.description: Oracle Consultant assigned to Exxon Mobile Executive Replacement Project
